mirror_contract.rule: The repository is the only semantic and versioning source; website downloads are convenience mirrors with preserved legacy paths.
update_procedure: Update the canonical portable in Moon-Source first.
Copy the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes to the mapped LUAHELENA moonsource/downloads path on a branch.
Run scripts/check_mirror_sync.py against the remote mirror or a local LUAHELENA checkout.
Open and review a website pull request; merge only after SHA-256 equality and production-surface review.
